dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell (Hans) phenotype: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: so this is not a recurrence of her 2016 ER-positive breast cancer

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III, B (stage IIIB), with the spleen recorded as S (nodal organ).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: with the spleen recorded as S (nodal organ)
stage_spleen_lymphatic.note: Treats spleen as nodal but does not explicitly explain why it does not make stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: fever to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: bulky at the NCCN 7.5 cm threshold but not at the Lugano 10 cm threshold

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the multifocal splenic nodules are scored as extranodal rather than nodal, the stage becomes IVB.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by immunohistochemistry (MYC approx 45%, BCL2 approx 70%) but not double-hit

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (low-intermediate): age 59 (0), Ann Arbor stage III (1), LDH above ULN (1)

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI is about 2 (stage III 1, LDH elevated 1

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Intermediate; CNS-directed prophylaxis is not indicated.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: R-CHOP, pola-R-CHP, DA-EPOCH-R and mini-R-CHOP all contain doxorubicin.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Start after the cardio-oncology optimization described below

tx_cardioprotection.quote: Start an ACE inhibitor or ARB (or sacubitril-valsartan) and an evidence-based beta-blocker (carvedilol or metoprolol succinate)

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Anthracycline-free immunochemotherapy: R-CEOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: With the anthracycline-free regimen below I expect somewhat lower efficacy

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: echocardiogram with GLS after cycle 3, at end of treatment
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Serial echo/GLS planned but troponin/NT-proBNP only as baseline, not serially.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6, scored by Lugano 2014

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: start allopurinol 300 mg daily 2-3 days before cycle 1
sup_tls_allopurinol.note: Allopurinol given but hydration deliberately limited because of LV dysfunction.

sup_gcsf.quote: primary pegfilgrastim (or on-body injector) on day 4 of each cycle

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue it to the planned completion in November 2026, pending agreement from breast medical oncology

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are all nonreactive, so she is HBV-susceptible

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: 12-lead ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, and the result of any ischemia evaluation
